meta.title: The Founding Partner program — Mobilcab
meta.description: Join the Founding Partner program before billing: 20% off paid plans (starting with Cut list) for 6 months from first payment. Enrollment closes when subscriptions open.

hero.label: The Founding Partner program
hero.title: Help shape the tool Romanian furniture makers actually need.
hero.body: We're not looking for testers for unfinished software. We're looking for furniture makers to build it with us. Join the program free now; when we open subscriptions (first paid plan: Cut list), Founding Partners get 20% off list for 6 months. Enrollment closes at billing. Anyone who joins later pays full list.

counter.full: All {total} Founding Partner spots have been claimed.

items.title: Free to join
items.body: You pay nothing to sign up. You're not obliged to buy when we open subscriptions. Enrollment closes at billing.

items.title: 20% off your subscription
items.body: When we move to paid plans, you get 20% off list for 6 months from first payment — on Cut list and on later plans that ship in that window (Atelier, CNC…). Anyone who joins later, without a place in the program, pays full list.

items.title: Your ideas on the development list
items.body: What you tell us is missing in the workshop goes onto a list of possible app developments. We build them when more people in the community want them — not just one workshop.

items.title: Your name on the list
items.body: You're listed among the people who helped build Mobilcab.

items.title: Direct contact
items.body: You talk with the founders (and the other FPs). We notify you personally when we open subscriptions, with list price and your discount.

steps: You're in the Founding Partner program — free, in your name (only until billing opens).
You use the app like everyone else — full Cut list on Free, with no export limits.
When we open subscriptions, we contact you with list price and your 20% discount. Founding Partner enrollment closes. Anyone who subscribes later, without a place in the program, pays full list.
